literal_meaning: ফাঁকা বা শূন্য স্থানের টুংটাং শব্দের অনুকরণ
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating emptiness or hollowness, such as empty pockets or stomach
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পকেট ঠনঠন, কোনো টাকা নেই।
পেট ঠনঠন করে ক্ষুধায় অসহ্য লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His pockets are empty; he has no money.
My stomach is rumbling with hunger, feeling completely empty.
note: Onomatopoeic idiom mimicking the hollow sound of emptiness, commonly used in informal Bengali speech.
